history.summary: D5 West Coast 2BR asking $1,663 psf - genuinely below verified recent transactions ($1,730 12-mo avg, $1,760 6-mo) - in a large, well-managed project with a real Jurong Lake District catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: This is the clearest buy in the batch and meets the v3.4 bar for high confidence: a verified value gap plus a dated catalyst in a favorable region. Asking $1,663 psf is below both the 12-month avg ($1,730, range $1,205-1,868) and the 6-month avg ($1,760), and below a Feb-2026 comp at $1,868 - so the -15.5% age-adj-cheap tag is corroborated by actual recent transactions, not a mis-scrape. D5 sits in the top realized-forward band (OCR/RCR ~+3.5-4%, far above CCR). The catalyst is concrete and policy-backed: Jurong Lake District is being built into Singapore's second CBD, directly supporting West Coast Vale pricing. 752-unit project with brisk rental activity (95 rentals in 6 months) gives strong liquidity and tenant demand; well-maintained per reviews; efficient 926sf 2BR. Leasehold (2020) is young with minimal decay. Value + catalyst + liquidity align.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=11 is adequate but not deep; only ~13 sale txns in 12 months despite the large project size
99-yr leasehold (lease decay clock, though ~93 yrs left = immaterial near-term)
Some units face PIE/expressway or West Coast Highway - facing/noise must be checked on the specific stack
catalysts: Jurong Lake District developing into Singapore's second CBD - major employment/price catalyst nearby
Asking $1,663 psf verified below recent transactions ($1,730 12-mo / $1,760 6-mo) - real entry discount
Proximity to Clementi MRT, Sungei Ulu Pandan park connector, and Pandan Reservoir
Large 752-unit project = strong rental demand (95 rentals/6 mo) and resale liquidity
